notes.title: I MADE A SONG for my INDIE GAME!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Gk0lzLnZ4wE;full][/previewyoutube]

I like games and music. 
You'd probably say "wow, it's like... 99% of the world population". Nah, I LIKE, LIKE games and music. I enjoy them so much, I even decided to make my own games. Aaaaand, you know, it's been... tough (!), but I didn't quit (yet) and instead, I sat over my desk and thought... and thought, and thought again, AND THEN I got to the idea of making my own superhero series! Listen, I love Batman, alright? Hell, who doesn’t love Batman! I was always watching new episodes of Batman Beyond as a kid and those are the best memories of my childhood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/b1af21a70fc05183d0a3569b53b696a86690d9b7.gif

So together with my friend Witek, we decided to really dedicate ourselves to that project and firstly - we made a free game called Hank: Straightjacket. It was… quite nice, but it was tiny, so the next step was to create something bigger, greater, more exciting and world changing (yeah I’m exaggerating a bit). The thing was - we didn’t know how to make it more… I don’t know, distinctive? iconic? So… we made a song!

https://youtu.be/lxFqR0UQG1Q?si=5oturWNEW8XFxYUx

Designing characters
But at first we had to design the characters - our main guy is Hank. He’s not your typical superhero with lots of money or a pretty face, in fact, he’s an alcoholic who many years ago was a master in street fighting at an underground arena. But one day his entire life fell off, he got drunk to death and when he woke up with a crazy hangover, he realised that he came in possession of a time travelling superpowers. There’s also his nemesis, Unraveler, the greatest illusionist this world has known, and many other characters but I won’t spoil too much, y-you have to try my game to learn more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/3967b09a17d1d4c3d506669c59dd4afce4463af6.png

But yeah, that’s basically the game, Unraveler poisoned Hank and took him into his world of illusion and now Hank has to escape, that’s the plot of Hank: Drowning On Dry Land. And although we know that all of this is cool and fun, we felt like there’s something missing. So we went back to watching Batman: Beyond, watched all the episodes for 10 times each and… nothing. We were slamming our heads against the wall and couldn’t come with the answer to our question: what is missing? And after days and nights with no sleep, tired and absolutely depressed, IN JUST ONE MOMENT we looked at eachother with Witek with that spark in our eyes and both said: THE SONG!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/9a5bb228f51f51daef12d6633e8252c762986e8c.png

The song
That was it! Every superhero has a theme song! And Hank also has to have one! We found the band that we thought would perfectly match the rock aesthetic we had in mind, guys are called Cinemon (you can check them out if you want) and we all were super excited to collaborate, so… we started working on it. It wasn’t a quick process, but let me tell you, the final result exceeded our wildest expectations. This raw, rock, grunge aesthetic is exactly what we were looking for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/26ec8cc83fe22358f7e417fff864264ca456e6e9.gif

The full song is already available at Cinemon’s youtube channel with a dedicated lyric video, you’ll find a link to it a bit higher in this article, a link to Hank: Drowning On Dry Land game on Steam is below. Go check it out, aaaand see you… in the nightmares!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937880/Hank_Drowning_On_Dry_Land/

notes.title: FART to the top, WIN a pig!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

This time we will focus mainly on Tales From The Arcade: Fartmania, because there is a lot to talk about! In addition, until the end of May you have a chance to take part in a contest where there is a cool prize to win!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/88b7fdd596856efc2c76bfebe49df7e2e54542a2.png

FARTMANIA IS OUT!(on Newgrounds)

Let's start with the fact that Fartmania is finally out. From now you can play our latest production on Newgrounds! We are very pleased with how TFTA Fartmania looks in the final version, another dream on our list ticked off. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/691b5c3d8b1c6716843158d8d706d17e276f7e22.gif

For those who do not yet know what our new game is about, we're here to tell you - Fartmania is a new installment in the Tales From The Arcade series. This time we decided to make an arcade platformer starring pigs. Our character Pinky has a farting problem and is being ridiculed by others in the village. However, when the other piglets are kidnapped by aliens, Pinky the Stinky must use his unusual powers and rescue his pals from the hands of the alien visitors. Will this mission succeed and will Pinky gain the respect of the village? It's all up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/be2bae62810e0e4e505faad69c5a5d07ff7fa877.gif

FART-ASTIC CONTEST!(Seriously, it's really cool!)

But you are probably also interested in the contest we’ve mentioned at the beginning. Well, we want to see how well you do in our new arcade platformer. Therefore, show us what the highest score you are able to fart out in Fartmania!

- Go to Newgrounds and play TFTA: Fartmania
- Launch the Fart-o-meter and start the adventure.
- Reach the top of the sky and defeat the aliens, completing the game in the shortest possible time and saving as many pigs as you can.

Every second counts, just as every little piglet is extra points to your score! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/fe259442b22bcdf2afe7507d465d620a49a5f744.gif

Okay, but what's all the fuss about? The person who at the end of the contest will appear in the first place of highscores on Newgrounds will become.... a character in TFTA: Fartmania! We will prepare for you a personalized piggy character that will appear in the game. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that may not be repeated. There is a lot to fight for, so drop on Newgrounds, break records and fart your way to the top!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/2916ff7b02cfb7a70e6ec089ecf595be95e20635.gif
(Become a character in Fartmania, just like our patreons Kaja and Adam!)

The contest runs until May 31, 2024.

So what are you waiting for? Stop reading and start farting! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Wishlist TFTA: Fartmania on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2883610/Tales_From_The_Arcade_Fartmania/

notes.title: Our crew is getting bigger!
notes.content:
Hey hey hey, there's a new pirate on this ship!

My name is Mateusz and for two months now I've been helping Kuba and Witek with their social media. Who am I exactly, how would I describe working with the My Next Games team and what are our plans for the future?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195882/37d19fb0490373403e35e81a1ace6f44657363f9.png

I have been running my YouTube channel for quite some time now and my content is mainly about Cyberpunk 2077 from CD Projekt RED. Making videos has been my hobby since I remember and I can hardly imagine anything else that gives me the same amount of joy. Besides that I'm also a self-taught Photoshop editor. I learned that skill because I couldn't stand my awful thumbnails on YouTube anymore, haha. But seriously, a couple years ago I had to choose: do I want to become an IT specialist or a graphic designer. I picked the first one and as time runs I think that I could've picked the second option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195882/b848d173f4fef74fe702d06fee1e807dcff6300f.gif

But hey, humans learn their whole lives, right? And after a consideration it's not even that bad, because now if I would like to have my own website, thanks to my IT skills from school I can make one by myself, while the rest of my graphic design skills I learned on my own. I consider this as an absolute win! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195882/27aee5cbd6125627ea923d9573d3e51109f15260.jpg

My other hobby is Video Games. That's why I decided to team-up with Kuba and Witek from My Next Games. The goal was simple - they make fun games and I use my experience to help them with the recognition of their series on the internet. We started very simply - they showed me their games, which by the way I really liked, especially the Hank one, and then I proceeded to think about new content for social media. At first on our Facebook, TikTok, Instagram etc. you could see just usual posts about our games. Nothing special. Then we extended our content to include articles and now we’ve just started with full YouTube videos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195882/d22f1c2c87b873b03a951b82360c52483274a413.png

And here we are today. We just released our first video, which you can find on our YouTube channel. It’s a summary of all upcoming Indie Games that were presented at this year’s The Game Awards. We invite you to check it out and to tell us in the comments what you like the most about this video and maybe what you don’t like about it. We’ll be very grateful.

Be with us on this journey and help us make better and better content for you. See you around!
